posts.title: Cover drop for the Italian edition of RED STAR HUSTLE
posts.description: Beyond proud that my novel RED STAR HUSTLE will be published in Italian by the magnificent Zona42, translated by the awesome Chiara Reali, who did such great work with the Italian edition of BLACKFISH CITY. OPERAZIONE RED STAR drops October 21st – and here is the incredible cover!!
